about.label: About
bio: I started in visual and editorial design, then moved through freelance and in-house roles into full-scope product design at MyLoyal in Copenhagen, where I've spent the last 5+ years building loyalty and engagement products for brands across Denmark. That graphic design foundation never left. It shows up as a stronger-than-average eye for type, colour and motion, sitting on top of research, systems thinking and interaction design.

I think visually first. I usually understand a problem by making something and looking at it, not by talking around it. Then I test it, cut what isn't working, and document what is. I follow design closely but I'm careful about what makes it into the work, taste before trend. I'm most useful in the messy middle of a project, turning an ambiguous problem into something that ships and holds up. Calm under pressure, observant, and happiest working closely with a team.
